label: V6.4.119 - MENU + CARGO + FOCUS STABILITY
notes: Remove My Flight back-arrow controls and their mutation loop; MENU is now the universal return-to-main control. Protect focused input/textarea/select fields from UI normalization churn to stop visible field flicker. Cargo/Kho hàng now renders its all-flight FSAGS 208 queue through the exact shared My Flight card/tile renderer used by operational roles, while retaining all-flight visibility, flight-number search, dossier access and receive/open FSAGS 208 actions.
message: V6.4.119: bỏ nút mũi tên quay lại, dùng MENU để trở về trang chính, ổn định field nhập và đồng bộ giao diện Kho hàng với My Flight chung.
